limits: The minor grapes together: at most 15%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Pinot Noir and Chardonnay sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.
land: Faces the morning sun. Early light dries the dew, which cuts disease, and the grapes are spared the hottest afternoon sun.

blurb.text: A Grand Cru in the commune of Chambolle-Musigny in the Côte de Nuits, made from Pinot Noir and Chardonnay. It is the only Côte de Nuits Grand Cru making both red and white, with red over 90% of output.
